question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing right midfielder, Bob is playing sweeper, and Claire is playing benchwarmer.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Alice and Claire trade positions. Then, Alice and Claire trade positions. Finally, Alice and Claire trade positions. At the end of the match, Alice is playing
Options:
(A) right midfielder
(B) sweeper
(C) benchwarmer
solution:
Positions in order (Alice, Bob, Claire):
Initial: (right midfielder, sweeper, benchwarmer)
1. Alice and Claire swap: (benchwarmer, sweeper, right midfielder)
2. Alice and Claire swap: (right midfielder, sweeper, benchwarmer)
3. Alice and Claire swap: (benchwarmer, sweeper, right midfielder)
Alice is the benchwarmer, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
